title: PortalMeta
description: Portal metadata served by the Go backend at GET /api/meta. Defines the portal domain, available plugins with their web bundles, feature flags, and build information. The client framework fetches this to discover and load Module Federation plugins at runtime.

feature_flags.description: Feature flags. Keys are normalized: uppercase, dots and hyphens become underscores (e.g. 'SOCIAL_LOGIN', 'ENABLE_BILLING').

meta.description: Arbitrary portal-level metadata. May include branding, configuration, or other data needed by the frontend.

buildInfo.description: Build information for the portal or a plugin. Generated at compile time from ldflags.

version.description: Semantic version or 'develop' for unreleased builds

portalMetaPlugins.description: Map of plugin ID to plugin metadata. Plugin IDs match the Go plugin registration ID (e.g. 'dashboard', 'billing', 'ipfs').

portalMetaPlugin.description: Metadata for a single plugin, including its web bundles and arbitrary plugin-specific metadata.

build.description: Plugin build information. Omitted if not available (omitempty).

meta.description: Plugin-specific metadata. Content depends on the plugin. Examples: subdomain, themes, social_providers for dashboard; quota limits for billing.

items.description: URL to a Module Federation manifest file. Server-served bundles use the pattern /api/meta/plugin/{pluginId}/bundle/{index}/mf-manifest.json. Dev-mode bundles use http://localhost:{port}/mf-manifest.json.

web_bundles.description: List of URIs to Module Federation manifest files. Each bundle can target different app types. The server rewrites publicPath in manifests to match the serving URL.
